testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.lw.DeleteOnQuitStartGateMiddlewareTest

testcase.name: held loads are released when the deletion fails open after its bound
the guard asks for the purge only for HISTORY and clears it at restore complete
a creation arriving as the gate opens cannot overtake held ones
the restore after a HISTORY deletion comes back without back-forward history
no deletion pending means nothing is held
link, custom tab, PWA and restored tabs get no engine session before the gate opens
